body_lead: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The Telangana High Court on Tuesday, November 3, took serious exception to the use of artificial intelligence (AI) by the Jangaon district Collector to dispose of a land dispute without independently examining the facts or hearing the affected party. The court suspended the Collector’s September 8 order and sought explanations from senior revenue and district officials. Justice NV Shravan Kumar was hearing a writ petition filed by Medipalli Komuraiah, a resident of Peddamadur village in Devaruppula mandal of Jangaon district.
